faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Bhilai Project Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the application for the Project Engineer post at IIT Bhilai is 15 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance to avoid last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Engineer in IIT Bhilai?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Engineer post in the Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai recruitment drive. This is a great opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIT Bhilai Project Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Project Engineer position at IIT Bhilai is Email. Candidates need to send their applications along with required documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Engineer post at IIT Bhilai?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Engineer post at IIT Bhilai is 45 years. There might be age relaxation for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for a Project Engineer at IIT Bhilai?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Project Engineer position at IIT Bhilai will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 40000 to Rs. 75000 per month. This is a competitive salary package.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications for the Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess ME/ MTech/BTech/MCA or equivalent in CSE or related areas to be eligible for the Project Engineer position at IIT Bhilai. Specific details are in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for IIT Bhilai Project Engineer Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Project Engineer posts at IIT Bhilai. Candidates can apply free of cost.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Project Engineer at IIT Bhilai?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Engineer post at IIT Bhilai primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and called for an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for the Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Engineer position is Bhilai, Chhattisgarh, with the Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai. It is a government job opportunity in a premier institute.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IIT Bhilai?
faq.answer: The official website for the Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai is https://www.iitbhilai.ac.in/. Candidates can visit this website for more information and updates regarding the recruitment.
